_doc: docs/06 s2.5, A11Y-06, UX-09: default bindings of the remappable flight actions, by name (keys: Godot key strings; pad: glyphs.json button ids; empty string = empty slot). Two key slots per action (yaw has A/Q and D/E as in 06 s3.1). Axes (sticks, triggers) and mouse buttons are not remappable in v1.0. Client-only, outside the content hash.
